en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with three photographs of the spa town Bad Elster. The top image shows a distant view of the town with a church tower surrounded by dense forested hills, labeled in German. The middle image depicts a long, modernist interior hall with large windows, columns, and display cases, labeled as the Wandelhalle (promenade hall). The bottom image shows an outdoor bathing or spa area with a rectangular basin or lawn, paths, and people gathered around, set against wooded hills, labeled Badeplatz.
